title: Return value of a pure timed computation
statement: A *timed computation* $\mathrm{TimeM}\,T\,\alpha$ records a return value in $\alpha$ together with an accumulated time cost in $T$. Suppose $T$ carries a distinguished zero element, and let $\mathrm{pure}\,a$ denote the timed computation that returns $a$ at zero cost. Then for every $a \in \alpha$, the return value of $\mathrm{pure}\,a$ is $a$.
hypotheses_covered: T has a zero element (Zero T)
the computation pure a : TimeM T α
